suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
})
csv_path  <- "inputs/expression-matrix-444444444444.csv"
xlsx_path <- "inputs/differential-results-333333333333.xlsx"
# --- Read differential analysis results ---
diff_df <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "Sheet 1") %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(log2FoldChange), !is.na(pvalue)) %>%
  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
# --- Read raw expression matrix (group structure & sanity check) ---
raw <- read.csv(csv_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
# First row was the group labels (group1/group2), second row was sample ids - reload correctly:
raw <- read.csv(csv_path, header = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
sample_names <- as.character(unlist(raw[1, -1]))
groups       <- as.character(unlist(raw[2, -1]))
expr_mat <- raw[-(1:2), ]
colnames(expr_mat) <- c("id", sample_names)
expr_mat[ , -1] <- lapply(expr_mat[ , -1], as.numeric)
cat("Samples per group:\n")
print(table(groups))
# --- Differential metrics ---
# Replace p == 0 (machine underflow) with machine minimum to avoid -Inf on -log10
min_pos_p <- min(diff_df$pvalue[diff_df$pvalue > 0])
diff_df$pvalue_safe <- ifelse(diff_df$pvalue <= 0, min_pos_p, diff_df$pvalue)
diff_df$neglog10p <- -log10(diff_df$pvalue_safe)
# --- Diagonal cut-off ---
# Cut-off: -log10(p) > k * |log2FC| + c
#   k : slope (per log2 unit)
#   c : intercept (baseline significance when FC == 1)
# Choosing slope so that:
#   at |log2FC| = 1  -> -log10(p) = c + k   ~ 1.3 (p ~ 0.05)
#   at |log2FC| = 2  -> -log10(p) = c + 2k  ~ 2.0 (p ~ 0.01)
# Slope k = 0.7, intercept c = 0.6 yields a sensible diagonal threshold.
slope     <- 0.7
intercept <- 0.6
diff_df$threshold <- slope * abs(diff_df$log2FoldChange) + intercept
diff_df$significant <- diff_df$neglog10p > diff_df$threshold
diff_df$direction <- with(diff_df, ifelse(!significant, "NS",
                                   ifelse(log2FoldChange > 0, "Up", "Down")))
diff_df$direction <- factor(diff_df$direction, levels = c("Up", "Down", "NS"))
cat("\nSignificance counts:\n")
print(table(diff_df$direction))
# --- Top labels ---
top_up <- diff_df %>% filter(direction == "Up")   %>% arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% head(10)
top_dn <- diff_df %>% filter(direction == "Down") %>% arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% head(10)
top_labels <- bind_rows(top_up, top_dn)
cat("\nTop labeled genes:\n")
print(top_labels[, c("id", "log2FoldChange", "neglog10p", "direction")])

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
})
# Build the plot data
plot_df <- diff_df
plot_df$label <- ifelse(plot_df$id %in% top_labels$id, plot_df$id, NA)
# Color palette (publication-grade)
col_up   <- "#D7263D"   # crimson
col_down <- "#1B6CA8"   # cobalt blue
col_ns   <- "#9E9E9E"   # gray
col_line <- "#2E2E2E"   # dark line
xlim_max <- max(abs(plot_df$log2FoldChange)) * 1.05
ylim_max <- max(plot_df$neglog10p) * 1.05
# Diagonal cut-off line: y = slope * |x| + intercept
x_seq <- seq(0, xlim_max, length.out = 200)
diag_df <- data.frame(x = c(x_seq, -rev(x_seq)),
                      y = c(slope * x_seq + intercept, slope * rev(x_seq) + intercept))
# Reference horizontal at p = 0.05
hline_df <- data.frame(y = -log10(0.05))
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglog10p)) +
  # diagonal cut-off line
  geom_line(data = diag_df, aes(x = x, y = y),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            color = col_line, linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed") +
  # horizontal p = 0.05 reference (subtle)
  geom_hline(data = hline_df, aes(yintercept = y),
             linetype = "dotted", color = col_line, linewidth = 0.4) +
  # points: NS first (back), Up & Down last
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, direction == "NS"),
             color = col_ns, size = 1.4, alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, direction == "Up"),
             color = col_up, size = 1.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, direction == "Down"),
             color = col_down, size = 1.7, alpha = 0.85) +
  # labels for significant top genes
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(plot_df, !is.na(label)),
    aes(label = label),
    size = 3.4, max.overlaps = 30, box.padding = 0.4,
    segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  # manual color legend (uses the direction factor with explicit palette)
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(Up = col_up, Down = col_down, NS = col_ns),
    labels = c(Up   = "Up-regulated",
               Down = "Down-regulated",
               NS   = "Not significant"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-xlim_max, xlim_max),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, ylim_max),
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Diagonal volcano plot — group2 vs group1",
    subtitle = sprintf("Diagonal cut-off: -log10(p) > %.2f * |log2FC| + %.2f    |    n = %d genes (%d Up, %d Down)",
                       slope, intercept,
                       nrow(plot_df),
                       sum(plot_df$direction == "Up"),
                       sum(plot_df$direction == "Down")),
    x = "log2(Fold Change)",
    y = expression(-log[10]~(p~value))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "grey30", size = 11),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )
# Add a colored layer that mirrors the points for legend entries only
p <- p + geom_point(data = data.frame(log2FoldChange = NA, neglog10p = NA,
                                      direction = factor(c("Up","Down","NS"),
                                                         levels = c("Up","Down","NS"))),
                    mapping = aes(color = direction), inherit.aes = FALSE, show.legend = TRUE)
# Show in preview (render here)
suppressWarnings(print(p))
# Save to PNG
out_png <- "diagonal_volcano.png"
ggsave(out_png, plot = p, width = 10, height = 7.5, dpi = 200, bg = "white")
cat("\nWrote:", out_png, "size:", file.info(out_png)$size, "bytes\n")

min_pos_p <- min(diff_df$pvalue[diff_df$pvalue > 0])
diff_df$pvalue_safe <- ifelse(diff_df$pvalue <= 0, min_pos_p, diff_df$pvalue)
diff_df$neglog10p  <- -log10(diff_df$pvalue_safe)
slope     <- 0.7

diff_df$threshold   <- slope * abs(diff_df$log2FoldChange) + intercept
diff_df$significant <- diff_df$neglog10p > diff_df$threshold
diff_df$direction   <- with(diff_df,

top_dn <- diff_df %>% filter(direction == "Down") %>% arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% head(10)

# Diagonal cut-off line: y = slope * |x| + intercept (V-shape)
x_seq <- seq(0, xlim_max, length.out = 200)
diag_df <- data.frame(x = c(x_seq, -rev(x_seq)),

                         color = direction, label = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
  # diagonal cut-off line (drawn under the points so points stay on top)
  geom_line(data = diag_df, aes(x = x, y = y),

    values = c(Up = col_up, Down = col_down, NS = col_ns),
    labels = c(Up   = "Up-regulated",
               Down = "Down-regulated",
